newsitem.title: USA: Santa Anita stake cut by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Santa Anita stake cut by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Friday it reduced its stake in Santa Anita Realty Enterprises Inc to 8.07 percent or 919,000 common shares.
On a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold a net of 133,000 shares between October 31 and December 11 at prices ranging from $23.375 to $27.125 a share.

Santa Anita Realty, which is based in Arcadia, Calif., owns the Santa Anita racetrack and interests in shopping centers. The company is traded on a paired basis with Santa Anita Operating Co, which conducts thoroughbred horse racing at the Santa Anita Park.
